items.title: 當AI房東穩賺？華爾街熱推資料中心 風險卻愈堆愈高
items.title_en: When AI Landlords Seem Surefire? Wall Street Pushes Data Centers, but Risks Keep Mounting
paras: AI熱潮帶動資料中心投資，華爾街正將這類基礎設施包裝成房地產配置選項，吸引投資人分享數位經濟成長。然而，從股價下跌、地方反對聲浪，到電力供應與資金流動性限制，風險也逐漸浮現，顯示資料中心並非只要搭上AI商機，就能穩賺租金。
據《CNBC》報導，這類投資目前仍以退休基金等機構法人為主，但黑石集團(BX-US)、藍鴞資本(Blue Owl)(OWL-US)等另類資產管理業者，正透過上市不動產投資信託(REIT)等方式，擴大投資人參與管道。

華爾街搶推資料中心投資 上市表現未必跟上AI熱潮

黑石今年推出Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust(BXDC-US)，鎖定北維吉尼亞、達拉斯等成熟市場的既有資料中心。執行長佩爾(Nick Pell)認為，相較於開發新案，投資營運成熟的設施風險較低，未來數年潛在市場規模可望突破1兆美元。
不過，該REIT於5月中旬以每股20美元發行8,750萬股，周四收盤已跌破17美元，較發行價下跌約16%，且目前尚未投入資金進行投資。資料中心REIT業者Equinix(EQIX-US)與Digital Realty Trust(DLR-US)長期表現雖佳，同期股價也陷入停滯。
藍鴞資本則傳出考慮將既有資料中心投資整合為上市REIT，估值最高65億美元。公司表示，在全球32個市場擁有逾130座資料中心，資產超過180億美元，並強調租約設有保障，即使租戶提前退出，也能取得補償。
然而，利率與美債殖利率上升會提高融資成本，也削弱收息型資產的吸引力。REIT今年漲幅多集中在債市壓力加劇前，8月以來已有不少相關投資遭到拋售。

地方反彈與電力瓶頸升溫 長約難擋所有開發風險

政治阻力也在擴大。蓋洛普調查顯示，70%美國民眾反對在住家附近興建資料中心。紐約州7月暫停核准新的超大規模資料中心，德州8月跟進，讓投資人必須重新評估許可延誤對預期報酬的影響。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)9月底針對新墨西哥州、由藍鴞資本開發的Project Jupiter資料中心園區發出不可抗力通知，若計畫未能於2028年投入營運，尋求延後付款，理由包括監管障礙與地方反對。儘管公司表示進度仍符合計畫，消息仍拖累股價下跌4%。
蓋茨堡學院財務教授莫拉(Sabur Mollah)指出，雲端、AI與資料儲存需求，確實可支撐資料中心長期發展，優質設施與大型科技公司簽訂長約，也有助取得穩定租金。
但這類資產需要龐大資本，仰賴可靠的電力、冷卻與網路設施，另有估值過高、租戶集中、技術過時、再融資及持續維護支出等風險。天災或設備停機，也可能讓業者無法履行服務承諾，保險只能協助分攤部分損失。

散戶參與管道增加 私募基金贖回限制須看清

目前散戶參與仍有限，黑石這檔上市REIT約94%由機構持有。不過，美國證券交易委員會(SEC)主席阿特金斯(Paul Atkins)近期提出擴大散戶參與私募投資的方案，相關產品未來可能更加普及。
投資人尤其需要區分上市REIT與私募基金。前者可在交易所買賣，後者可能設有贖回窗口及額度限制，能買進不代表隨時能取回資金。InvestCloud主管塔弗(Andrew Tarver)指出，私募市場原本是為少數機構的大額、低頻交易設計，未必適合大量散戶頻繁進出。
財富顧問法爾肯(Jake Falcon)認為，資料中心基金可作為小比例、長期配置，但投資前仍須確認是否符合資金用途與整體目標，並充分理解產品結構，不能只因AI題材熱門就貿然投入。
paras_en: The AI boom is driving data‑center investment, and Wall Street is packaging this infrastructure as a real‑estate allocation option to let investors share in the digital‑economy growth. Yet risks are emerging—from falling stock prices and local opposition to power‑supply constraints and liquidity limits—showing that data centers aren’t a guaranteed rent‑check just because they ride the AI wave.

According to CNBC, most of this capital currently comes from institutional investors such as pension funds, but alternative‑asset managers like Blackstone (BX‑US) and Blue Owl (OWL‑US) are expanding investor access through publicly listed REITs.

Wall Street is aggressively promoting data‑center investments, but listed performance may not keep pace with the AI hype. Blackstone launched the Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust (BXDC‑US) this year, targeting existing data‑center assets in mature markets such as Northern Virginia and Dallas. CEO Nick Pell argues that buying and operating mature facilities carries lower risk than greenfield development, and the market could exceed $1 trillion in the next few years.

However, the REIT issued 87.5 million shares at $20 each in mid‑May and closed Thursday below $17, about a 16% discount to the IPO price, and it has yet to deploy any capital. While data‑center REITs like Equinix (EQIX‑US) and Digital Realty Trust (DLR‑US) have performed well over the long term, their stock prices have also stalled recently.

Blue Owl is reportedly considering bundling its existing data‑center holdings into a listed REIT, with a valuation that could reach $6.5 billion. The firm says it operates more than 130 data centers across 32 markets, with assets over $18 billion, and stresses that leases are protected so that even if a tenant exits early, compensation is secured.

Rising interest rates and U.S. Treasury yields increase financing costs and diminish the appeal of yield‑focused assets. REIT gains this year were largely concentrated before bond‑market pressure intensified, and many related positions have been sold off since August.

Local backlash and power‑supply bottlenecks are adding to development risk. A Gallup poll shows 70% of Americans oppose building data centers near residential areas. New York halted approvals for new hyperscale data centers in July, and Texas followed in August, forcing investors to reassess the impact of permitting delays on expected returns.

Oracle (ORCL‑US) issued a force‑majeure notice at the end of September for the Project Jupiter data‑center campus in New Mexico, being developed by Blue Owl. If the project cannot be operational by 2028, Oracle will seek delayed payments, citing regulatory hurdles and local opposition. Although the company says the schedule remains on track, the news dragged the stock down 4%.

Finance professor Sabur Mollah of Gatesburg College notes that cloud, AI and data‑storage demand can indeed sustain long‑term data‑center growth; high‑quality facilities with long‑term contracts from large tech firms help secure stable rent streams.

But these assets require massive capital, reliable power, cooling and network infrastructure, and face risks such as overvaluation, tenant concentration, technological obsolescence, refinancing needs and ongoing maintenance costs. Natural disasters or equipment failures could prevent operators from meeting service commitments, with insurance only covering part of the loss.

Retail investor participation remains limited; about 94% of Blackstone’s listed REIT is held by institutions. However, SEC Chair Paul Atkins has recently proposed expanding retail access to private‑investment products, which could make such offerings more common in the future.

Investors need to distinguish between listed REITs and private funds. The former trade on exchanges, while the latter may have redemption windows and caps, meaning buying does not guarantee immediate cash‑out. Andrew Tarver of InvestCloud points out that the private market was designed for a few institutions’ large, low‑frequency trades and may not suit frequent retail turnover.

Wealth advisor Jake Falcon says data‑center funds can be a small‑percentage, long‑term allocation, but investors should verify that they fit their liquidity needs and overall objectives and fully understand the product structure, rather than jumping in simply because AI is trendy.

items.title: 美債還沒跌完？四大警訊浮現 殖利率恐再衝高
items.title_en: U.S. Treasuries Still Not Fully Fallen? Four Major Warning Signs Emerge, Yields May Surge Again
paras: 美債殖利率攀抵逾20年高點，市場擔心賣壓可能愈演愈烈。從利率選擇權避險需求升溫、AI企業大舉發債，到房貸資產避險與長天期公債承壓，四項訊號顯示，債市拋售可能形成連鎖反應，進一步推高殖利率。
據《路透》報導，自2月美伊戰爭爆發以來，10年期美債殖利率累計上升約135個基點至5.23%；30年期殖利率則自3月低點上升約110個基點至5.614%，雙雙來到20多年前才見過的水準。
不過，高殖利率也可能吸引買盤，讓投資人鎖定小布希執政以來少見的收益水準。市場目前關注的是，這股承接力能否抵銷避險交易與資金調整所帶來的額外賣壓。

利率避險需求升溫 市場防範殖利率再衝高

第一項警訊來自利率選擇權。投資人正加碼防範利率上升的保護性部位，希望在不出售美債持倉的情況下，降低殖利率急升造成的損失。
針對未來三個月10年期美元利率交換利率上升200個基點的避險需求明顯增加，相關保護成本周一升至132個基點，創2023年3月矽谷銀行倒閉引發銀行危機以來最高。
利率交換是以固定利率交換浮動利率的契約。雖然這類選擇權連結的是交換利率，而非美債殖利率，但兩者通常同向變動，因此防範利率上漲的選擇權相對昂貴，反映市場對長期美債殖利率續升的擔憂。
此外，10年期利率交換的一個月期選擇權隱含波動率升至21.4個基點，創3月底以來最高，顯示市場對長期利率走勢的不確定性增加。

AI發債與房貸避險交織 美債承受額外賣壓

第二項壓力來自AI基礎建設融資。大型科技業者為擴建資料中心等設施，持續發行公司債。雖然信用利差仍低，但買進這些長天期債券的投資人，會透過賣出美債期貨，降低投資組合對利率上升的敏感度。
RBC BlueBay Asset Management投資組合經理Neil Sun表示，公司債交易中午定價後，下午往往就出現大量美債期貨賣單。部分投資人則直接出售美債，騰出資金買進收益率較高的投資等級公司債。
高盛(GS-US)預估，大型雲端與AI業者明年發債規模可能達創紀錄的4,200億美元，意味相關避險或美債出售需求可能持續增加。
第三項警訊是房貸資產避險加速。利率上升時，借款人提前還款或轉貸的意願下降，房貸抵押證券(MBS)的預期存續期間因而拉長，也更容易受到利率進一步上升的衝擊。
投資人通常會增加利率避險，包括賣出美債期貨，抵銷這種新增風險。這類「凸性避險」可能形成循環：殖利率愈升，避險賣盤愈多，又進一步加重債市壓力。
Eris Innovations執行長Mike Riddle指出，過去三年承作的房貸中，有相當大一部分票面利率接近目前房貸利率，因此可能引發更多避險需求，本月九筆大型交易已顯示投資人積極保護部位。

長債殖利率升得更快 財政疑慮推高持債補償

第四項訊號是10年期與30年期美債殖利率差距再度擴大。本周兩者利差約37個基點，反映30年期殖利率上升速度更快，投資人要求更高報酬，才願意持有最長天期公債。
這項利差雖仍低於7月底的52個基點，但目前殖利率已接近數十年高點，顯示市場變化愈來愈反映「期限溢價」上升，也就是持有長期債券所要求的額外補償，而不只是重新評估聯準會(Fed)利率政策。
F/m Investments共同創辦人Alex Morris表示，投資人對10年期美債的興趣高於30年期，因為時間拉長，美國財政出問題的可能性也更令人擔憂。這反映市場對政府能否掌控長期財政局勢，仍缺乏信心。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have climbed to over‑20‑year highs, prompting market fears that selling pressure could intensify. From rising demand for interest‑rate option hedges and a wave of AI‑company bond issuances to mortgage‑asset hedging and pressure on long‑dated sovereign bonds, four signals suggest a bond‑market sell‑off could trigger a chain reaction that pushes yields higher.

According to Reuters, since the outbreak of the U.S.–Iran war in February, the 10‑year Treasury yield has risen about 135 basis points to 5.23%, while the 30‑year yield has climbed roughly 110 basis points since its March low to 5.614%, both levels last seen more than two decades ago.

However, high yields could also attract buyers, allowing investors to lock in a return level rarely seen since the Bush administration. The market is now watching whether this buying strength can offset the extra selling pressure generated by hedging trades and fund reallocations.

Rising demand for rate hedges signals market concerns that yields could climb further. The first warning comes from interest‑rate options, as investors increase protective positions against rising rates, hoping to limit losses from a rapid yield surge without having to sell Treasury holdings.

Hedging demand for a 200‑basis‑point rise in the 10‑year USD interest‑rate swap over the next three months has surged, pushing the related protection cost up to 132 basis points on Monday – the highest since the March 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse triggered a banking crisis.

An interest‑rate swap is a contract that exchanges a fixed rate for a floating rate. Although these options are linked to swap rates rather than Treasury yields, the two usually move in tandem, making rate‑rise protection relatively expensive and reflecting market worries that long‑term Treasury yields will keep climbing.

In addition, the one‑month implied volatility of the 10‑year swap option rose to 21.4 basis points, the highest since the end of March, indicating growing uncertainty about the trajectory of long‑term rates.

AI‑driven financing adds a second pressure. Large tech firms are continuously issuing corporate bonds to fund data‑center expansions and other infrastructure. While credit spreads remain low, investors buying these long‑dated bonds often hedge by selling Treasury futures to reduce portfolio sensitivity to rising rates.

Neil Sun, portfolio manager at RBC BlueBay Asset Management, said that after corporate‑bond pricing settles at midday, a flood of Treasury‑future sell orders typically appears in the afternoon. Some investors even sell Treasuries outright to free up cash for higher‑yielding investment‑grade corporate debt.
Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) estimates that large cloud and AI companies could issue a record $420 billion in bonds next year, meaning hedging or Treasury‑selling demand could stay elevated.

The third warning is accelerating mortgage‑asset hedging. When rates rise, borrowers are less likely to prepay or refinance, extending the expected life of mortgage‑backed securities (MBS) and making them more vulnerable to further rate hikes.

Investors usually increase rate hedges, including selling Treasury futures, to offset this added risk. Such “convexity hedging” can become a feedback loop: higher yields spur more hedge‑sell orders, which in turn adds pressure to the bond market.

Mike Riddle, CEO of Eris Innovations, noted that a large portion of the mortgages originated over the past three years carry coupon rates close to current mortgage rates, potentially spurring more hedging demand; nine large deals this month already show investors actively protecting their positions.

The fourth signal is a widening spread between 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields. This week the spread is about 37 basis points, reflecting faster gains in the 30‑year yield and investors demanding higher compensation to hold the longest‑dated sovereign debt.

Although the spread remains below the 52‑basis‑point gap seen at the end of July, yields are now near multi‑decade highs, indicating the market is increasingly pricing in a higher term premium – extra compensation for holding long‑dated bonds beyond just reassessing the Fed’s policy stance.

Alex Morris, co‑founder of F/m Investments, said investors favor the 10‑year over the 30‑year because the longer horizon raises concerns about U.S. fiscal stability. This reflects lingering doubts about the government’s ability to manage long‑term fiscal risks.

items.title: 撤換Fed理事再出招！川普組調查小組 庫克律師嗆走過場
items.title_en: Trump Administration Moves Again to Oust Fed Governor Cook; Trump Team Investigates, Cook's Lawyer Calls It a Stunt
paras: 美國總統川普再度推進撤換聯準會(Fed)理事庫克(Lisa Cook)的行動，正式成立調查委員會，檢視她涉嫌在房貸文件中作出不實陳述的指控，並要求她於11月5日赴白宮出席不公開聽證會。庫克否認不法，其律師質疑程序合法性，但表示願意提出事實，證明沒有將她免職的法律依據。
綜合外媒報導，白宮周五(9日)公布一份日期為周三的總統備忘錄，要求委員會調查相關指控，並向川普報告，是否存在《聯邦準備法》所要求、足以撤換Fed理事的法定事由。聽證會安排在期中選舉後兩天，庫克可事先提交書面陳述，並由律師陪同出席。

白宮官員組成調查小組 庫克律師質疑程序公正性

委員會三名成員均來自行政部門，包括白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特(Kevin Hassett)、政府倫理局代理局長桑德林(Keith Sonderling)，以及公平就業機會委員會主席盧卡斯(Andrea Lucas)，未列入外部獨立人士。委員會可諮詢司法部及其他機關，協助調查。
川普在備忘錄中表示，總統有責任確保法律忠實執行，包括撤換無法被信任會誠實陳述及遵守法律的下屬。他長期要求Fed降息，近期更將自己提名的主席華許未能降息，歸咎於「充滿敵意」的理事會。
庫克的律師羅威爾(Abbe Lowell)與艾森(Norm Eisen)表示，川普已多次表明不論證據為何都要撤換庫克，因此對聽證會是否合法抱持重大疑慮。他們正與白宮接洽，確認程序是否具有實質意義，而非只是走過場。
律師強調，只要調查接近客觀，就會得出庫克未涉及房貸詐欺、沒有理由將她免職的結論。Fed則不予置評，請媒體洽詢庫克律師。

最高法院要求正當程序 免職事由仍是攻防核心

川普去年8月首度宣布撤換庫克，起因是聯邦住房金融局局長普爾特(Bill Pulte)指控她在貸款申請中說謊，以取得優惠條件。庫克隨即提告，否認指控，並主張相關指控不足以構成法定免職事由。
最高法院今年6月以5比4裁定，庫克可在訴訟期間留任，認為川普先前未給予充分通知及辯護機會，但未禁止白宮重新啟動程序。判決曾援引前總統塔虎脫1912年成立調查委員會的案例，卻未具體規定程序形式。
福坦莫大學法學教授曼納斯(Jane Manners)認為，川普此舉看似回應最高法院的程序要求，但法院對撤換Fed理事的事由設下高門檻，並強調央行應免於政治干預，這仍將是後續訴訟核心。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫批評，川普正透過不合法的「作秀審判」企圖控制央行。司法部與庫克律師預定11月6日、也就是聽證會隔天，向華府聯邦法官提交報告，說明原有訴訟的後續安排。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump is once again pushing to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, formally establishing an investigative committee to examine accusations that she made false statements in mortgage documents, and demanding she appear at a closed‑door hearing at the White House on November 5. Cook denies any wrongdoing, her lawyer questions the legality of the process, but says she will present facts to show there is no legal basis for her removal.

According to foreign media reports, the White House on Friday the 9th released a presidential memorandum dated Wednesday that orders the committee to investigate the allegations and report to Trump whether there are statutory grounds under the Federal Reserve Act sufficient to remove a Fed governor. The hearing is scheduled for two days after the midterm elections; Cook may submit a written statement in advance and be accompanied by counsel.

White House officials have formed the investigative panel, and Cook's lawyer has raised concerns about procedural fairness. All three committee members come from the executive branch: Kevin Hassett, director of the White House National Economic Council; Keith Sonderling, acting director of the Office of Government Ethics; and Andrea Lucas, chair of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. No external independent members were appointed. The committee may consult the Justice Department and other agencies for assistance.

In the memorandum, Trump wrote that the president has a duty to ensure faithful execution of the law, including removing subordinates who cannot be trusted to be honest and comply with the law. He has long pressed the Fed to cut rates, and recently blamed his own nominee for chair Wes Moore’s failure to cut rates on a "hostile" board of governors.

Cook's attorneys, Abbe Lowell and Norm Eisen, said Trump has repeatedly indicated he will fire Cook regardless of the evidence, raising serious doubts about the legality of the hearing. They are in talks with the White House to confirm whether the process has any substantive meaning or is merely a perfunctory exercise.

The lawyers emphasized that if the investigation is conducted objectively, it will conclude that Cook was not involved in mortgage fraud and there is no justification for her removal. The Fed declined to comment and directed media inquiries to Cook's counsel.

The Supreme Court has demanded due process, keeping the grounds for removal at the heart of the dispute. Trump first announced his intent to oust Cook in August last year after Federal Housing Finance Agency head Bill Pulte accused her of lying on loan applications to secure favorable terms. Cook promptly sued, denied the allegations, and argued the claims do not meet the statutory threshold for removal.

In June this year the Supreme Court ruled 5‑4 that Cook may remain in office during the litigation, finding that Trump had not provided adequate notice and an opportunity to defend, but it did not bar the White House from restarting the removal process. The decision cited a 1912 investigation committee established by former President Taft, but did not specify procedural details.

Law professor Jane Manners of Fordham University said Trump's move appears to respond to the Supreme Court's procedural demands, but the Court has set a high bar for grounds to remove a Fed governor and stressed that the central bank should be insulated from political interference, which will remain a key issue in future lawsuits.

Senate Banking Committee Democratic ranking member Sherrod Brown criticized Trump for attempting to control the central bank through an unlawful "show trial." The Justice Department and Cook's lawyers plan to file a report with a federal judge in Washington on November 6, the day after the hearing, outlining the next steps in the existing litigation.

items.title: 柴油飆漲70%！川普放話有重大消息 要狠狠壓下漲勢
items.title_en: Diesel Prices Surge 70%—Trump Promises Major Announcement to Slam the Rally
paras: 美國柴油價格逼近歷史高點，總統川普周五(9日)預告，將針對柴油問題發布「重大消息」，但未透露具體措施。在決定國會控制權的11月3日期中選舉前，高油價持續構成民生與政治壓力。
川普在白宮活動上表示：「我們即將就柴油發布一項重大宣布。」他接著說，柴油問題將有重大消息，並誓言要狠狠打壓這波漲勢，但未進一步說明政策內容或公布時間。
自美國與以色列對伊朗開戰以來，美國柴油價格已上漲70%。川普近期雖已採取兩項備受矚目的增供措施，包括施壓盟友釋出緊急儲備，以及放寬免稅紅色染料柴油的使用範圍，仍未能扭轉價格高漲的局面。
美伊戰爭與俄烏戰爭引發前所未見的全球燃料供應緊縮。根據美國汽車協會(AAA)數據，美國周四平均柴油價格達每加侖6.28美元，維持在接近歷史紀錄的水準。
paras_en: U.S. diesel prices are nearing historic highs, and President Trump on Friday (the 9th) warned that he will issue a "major announcement" on the diesel issue, though he did not disclose specific measures. Ahead of the November 3 midterm elections that will determine control of Congress, persistently high fuel prices continue to create pressure on households and politics.

At a White House event, Trump said, "We are about to make a major announcement on diesel." He added that there will be significant news regarding the diesel problem and pledged to hit this price surge hard, without providing further details on the policy or a timeline for its release.

Since the United States and Israel went to war with Iran, U.S. diesel prices have risen by 70%. Although Trump recently took two high‑profile steps to increase supply—pressuring allies to release emergency reserves and expanding the tax‑exempt use of red‑dye diesel—these actions have not reversed the price climb.

The U.S.–Iran war and the Russia‑Ukraine conflict have triggered an unprecedented tightening of global fuel supplies. According to data from the American Automobile Association (AAA), the average diesel price in the United States on Thursday was $6.28 per gallon, staying near historic record levels.

items.title: AI需求看不到盡頭 Lumentum：光學元件訂單滿到2029年 部分產品缺口達七成
items.title_en: AI Demand Shows No End in Sight Lumentum: Optical Component Orders Booked Through 2029, Some Products Face a 70% Shortfall
paras: Lumentum Holdings(LITE-US)執行長Michael Hurlston周五(9日)表示，由於科技業爭相興建更高速的人工智慧(AI)資料中心，該公司接下來到2029年初的光學元件產能已被「預訂一空」。
Hurlston在東京受訪時表示，該公司部分產品從現在一直到明年的需求，將有約七成無法滿足，其他一些產品的需求缺口，甚至到2028年仍有三成無法供應。僅僅六個月前，Hurlston曾表示，Lumentum產能要到2028年才會售罄。
Lumentum與同業Coherent(COHR-US)今年稍早各自獲得輝達(NVDA-US)20億美元投資。Lumentum供應先進磷化銦元件，協助實現高速雲端運算與資料傳輸。分析師預期，Lumentum今年營收將較去年成長逾一倍。
Hurlston說：「我們真的在努力迎頭趕上，盡可能快速擴充產能，但與客戶的需求相比，我們仍落後非常、非常多。產能已經全部售罄，因此看不到需求何時才會出現盡頭。」

AI基建需求強 供應商擴產仍追不上

隨著全球大舉興建資料中心及其他AI基礎設施，部分投資人開始對隨之而來的成本上升與債務膨脹更加謹慎。為了緩解關鍵供應商的疑慮，大型科技公司開始為長期協議提供保障。
此外，隨著美國傳出考慮禁止新款中國光收發器上市，業界也正為供應進一步吃緊做準備。Counterpoint Research指出，若光迅科技(Innolight)等中國廠商留下供應缺口，Lumentum與Coherent也無法完全填補。
為因應激增的需求，Lumentum過去兩年已將東京都會區主要工廠的產能擴大至12倍。該公司計劃在該廠及鄰近設施投資至少3.5億美元，並已擴充位於英國卡斯威爾(Caswell)的工廠產能。
不過Hurlston表示，若要擴大產品線，可能必須考慮透過併購取得新技術或能力。他說：「我認為，我們可能希望在未來一年內，為現有業務增加額外的產能。」
Hurlston表示，像Lumentum這類公司，通常需要三到五年才能建置新的產能，不過超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)已同意投入資金支持。

矽光子技術受矚目 日本供應鏈握優勢

矽光子技術利用光傳輸資料。由於先進AI硬體對傳輸速度的要求不斷提高，矽光子預料將逐步取代資料中心叢集內以銅為基礎的互連技術。光學網路也有助於降低系統產生的熱量與耗電量。
日本擁有廣泛的相關技術供應鏈，涵蓋磷化銦半導體、光纖及矽光子技術，代表企業包括藤倉(Fujikura)、住友電工(Sumitomo Electric Industries)、古河電工(Furukawa Electric)、濱松光子學(Hamamatsu Photonics)、三菱電機(Mitsubishi Electric)及日立高新技術(Hitachi High-Tech)。
Lumentum部分技術來自日本，因該公司在2018年收購承接了日立(Hitachi)光學研究成果的Oclaro。Lumentum位於日本相模原的廠區，如今已是全球最先進的磷化銦元件生產據點之一，具備穩定供應高品質產品的能力。
今年稍早，以色列矽光子晶圓代工業者Tower Semiconductor取得日本中部富山縣魚津市一座300毫米晶圓廠的控制權，並計劃擴大光子產品出貨量。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) CEO Michael Hurlston said on Friday (the 9th) that, as the tech industry races to build faster AI data centers, the company’s optical component capacity through early 2029 is already "fully booked."

Hurlston told reporters in Tokyo that demand for some of the company’s products from now until next year will be about 70% unmet, and the shortfall for other products will remain at roughly 30% even through 2028. Just six months ago, Hurlston had said Lumentum’s capacity would not be sold out until 2028.

Earlier this year Lumentum and peer Coherent (COHR-US) each secured a $2 billion investment from Nvidia (NVDA-US). Lumentum supplies advanced indium phosphide components that enable high‑speed cloud computing and data transmission. Analysts expect Lumentum’s revenue this year to more than double that of last year.

Hurlston said, "We are really working hard to catch up, expanding capacity as quickly as possible, but we are still far, far behind customer demand. Capacity is completely sold out, so we can’t see when demand will ever run out."

AI infrastructure demand is strong, but suppliers’ capacity expansions are still lagging. As data centers and other AI infrastructure are built worldwide, some investors are becoming more cautious about rising costs and debt. To ease key suppliers’ concerns, large tech firms are beginning to provide guarantees for long‑term agreements.

In addition, with reports that the United States is considering banning new Chinese optical transceivers from the market, the industry is preparing for tighter supply. Counterpoint Research notes that if Chinese firms such as Innolight leave a supply gap, Lumentum and Coherent will not be able to fill it completely.

To meet the surge in demand, Lumentum has expanded capacity at its main plant in the Tokyo metropolitan area twelve‑fold over the past two years. The company plans to invest at least $350 million in that plant and nearby facilities and has also expanded capacity at its factory in Caswell, United Kingdom.

However, Hurlston said that expanding the product line may require acquiring new technology or capabilities through acquisitions. He added, "I think we may want to add additional capacity to our existing business within the next year."
Hurlston noted that companies like Lumentum typically need three to five years to build new capacity, but hyperscale cloud providers have agreed to fund the effort.

Silicon‑photonics technology is attracting attention, and Japan’s supply chain holds an advantage. Silicon photonics uses light to transmit data. As advanced AI hardware demands ever‑higher transmission speeds, silicon photonics is expected to gradually replace copper‑based interconnects inside data‑center clusters. Optical networking also helps reduce system heat and power consumption.

Japan has a broad related‑technology supply chain covering indium‑phosphide semiconductors, optical fiber and silicon‑photonics, with representative companies including Fujikura, Sumitomo Electric Industries, Furukawa Electric, Hamamatsu Photonics, Mitsubishi Electric and Hitachi High‑Tech.

Some of Lumentum’s technology comes from Japan, as the company acquired Oclaro in 2018, which had taken over Hitachi’s optical research results. Lumentum’s plant in Sagamihara, Japan, is now one of the world’s most advanced indium‑phosphide component production sites, capable of reliably supplying high‑quality products.

Earlier this year, Israeli silicon‑photonics wafer foundry Tower Semiconductor acquired control of a 300‑mm wafer fab in Uozu, Toyama Prefecture, Japan, and plans to expand its photonics product shipments.

items.title: 利率飆也打不趴？科技股抗跌線索藏在選擇權
items.title_en: Rising Rates Can't Knock Down? Tech Stocks' Resilience Hints Hidden in Options
paras: 利率攀升、人工智慧(AI)營收前景遭質疑，科技股卻仍展現韌性，線索或許藏在選擇權市場。交易員近月持續增加下跌保護，這些避險部位可能在市場回落時提供支撐，但大型交易的多空方向仍分歧。
《金融時報》報導OpenAI營收不如預期後，那斯達克100指數周四盤中一度下跌1.8%。Barchart數據顯示，追蹤該指數的Invesco QQQ Trust(QQQ-US)，賣權與買權未平倉合約比率升至1.49，創6月底以來最高。
這並非單日現象。自8月以來，儘管大型科技股持續走高，該比率已逐步攀升。周三最大兩筆選擇權交易，分別涉及SPDR標普500 ETF(SPY-US)與Meta(META-US)，方向也都偏空，反映交易員防範利率上升或AI題材動搖帶來的回檔。
避險部位累積，可能讓跌勢獲得緩衝，因為投資人可將避險獲利了結，降低賣出股票的壓力。不過，SPY與標普500指數選擇權的賣權買權比仍接近平均，顯示這種布局並非遍及整體市場。
此外，QQQ周四正常交易時段的大單反而偏多。一筆交易賣出近5,000口明年3月到期、履約價740美元的賣權，收取約1,500萬美元權利金；另一筆則斥資逾800萬美元，買進6,500口同月到期、履約價835美元的買權，押注後續上漲。
盤後風向又轉空。有交易員花費1,600萬美元，買進15,000口明年1月15日到期、履約價680美元的賣權，同時賣出同口數、10月16日到期的760美元買權，收取400萬美元。
TheoTrade共同創辦人考夫曼(Don Kaufman)認為，美債波動與OpenAI消息都未造成太大衝擊。市場仍可能下跌，但若要形成持續性賣壓，必須有更強的拋售力道，才能打破目前承接跌勢的格局。
paras_en: Higher interest rates and doubts about AI revenue prospects have not stopped tech stocks from showing resilience, and the clue may lie in the options market. Traders have been steadily increasing downside protection in recent weeks, and these hedges could provide support if the market pulls back, though the direction of large‑scale trades remains divided.

The Financial Times reported that after OpenAI's revenue fell short of expectations, the Nasdaq‑100 index slipped as much as 1.8% during Thursday's session. Barchart data shows that the put‑to‑call open‑interest ratio for the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ‑US), which tracks the index, rose to 1.49 – the highest level since the end of June.

This is not a one‑day phenomenon. Since August, even as mega‑cap tech stocks have kept climbing, the ratio has been gradually climbing. On Wednesday, the two biggest options trades involved the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY‑US) and Meta (META‑US), and both were bearish, reflecting traders' hedging against a pullback from rising rates or a wobble in AI‑related themes.

The buildup of hedges could cushion a decline because investors can lock in profits on those hedges, reducing the pressure to sell stocks. However, the put‑to‑call ratio for SPY and S&P 500 index options remains near average, indicating that this positioning is not pervasive across the whole market.

Moreover, large orders in QQQ during Thursday’s regular session were actually net‑long. One trade sold nearly 5,000 contracts of March‑next‑year, $740 strike puts, collecting about $15 million in premium; another spent over $8 million to buy 6,500 contracts of March‑next‑year, $835 strike calls, betting on further upside.

After hours, the wind turned bearish. A trader spent $16 million to buy 15,000 contracts of January 15‑next‑year, $680 strike puts, while simultaneously selling the same number of $760 strike calls expiring on October 16, pocketing $4 million.

Don Kaufman, co‑founder of TheoTrade, believes that U.S. Treasury volatility and the OpenAI news have not caused a major impact. The market may still fall, but to generate sustained selling pressure a stronger wave of sell‑offs is needed to break the current pattern that is absorbing the decline.

items.title: 股市熱荷包卻冷！美國密大10月消費者信心降至46.3 現況指數創歷史新低
items.title_en: Stock Market Hot Wallet Yet Cold! US Michigan October Consumer Confidence Falls to 46.3, Current Conditions Index Hits Historic Low
paras: 美國消費者信心10月上旬持續下滑，對當前經濟情勢的評價更創歷史新低。油價居高不下、借貸成本上升與招聘放緩，加重家庭財務壓力，低收入及股票資產較少的族群尤其悲觀，通膨預期也同步攀升。
密西根大學周五(9日)公布，10月消費者信心指數初值由9月的48.1降至46.3，創5月以來最低，低於《路透》調查預估的47.8。現況指數由50.9降至44.7，創歷史新低；預期指數則由46.3升至47.3，為7月以來首次回升。
消費者預估未來一年通膨率為4.7%，高於9月的4.6%，也明顯高於美伊戰爭爆發前、2月的3.4%；未來五至十年的長期通膨預期則由3.4%升至3.5%，顯示物價疑慮仍未消退。
調查主任Joanne Hsu表示，民眾對生活成本的不滿持續累積，低收入及股票投資部位較小的消費者，因較缺乏因應漲價的財務資源，本月信心大幅下滑。民主黨與共和黨支持者信心雖回升，仍被無黨派民眾的降幅抵銷。
她指出，儘管政治立場不同，各陣營消費者均認為，相較於年初美伊戰爭爆發前，經濟前景已轉弱。近期整體物價漲幅超過薪資增幅，也進一步壓縮家庭預算。
本月消費者對自身當前財務狀況的評價持平，未來一年個人財務與景氣預期略有改善，但高物價與高利率讓耐久財購買意願相關指標降至歷史新低。
同日發布的高油價影響專題調查顯示，僅約31%受訪者預期未來一年維持平常支出，逾半打算削減家用品、汽車、外食或旅遊開銷。不過，今年信心雖長期低迷，穩定的就業市場與強勁股市仍支撐實際消費。
本次調查期間為9月22日至10月5日。
paras_en: US consumer confidence in early October continued to slip, with its assessment of the current economic situation hitting a historic low. High oil prices, rising borrowing costs and a slowdown in hiring have increased household financial pressure, especially pessimistic among low‑income households and those with fewer stock assets, and inflation expectations have risen in tandem.

The University of Michigan released on Friday (the 9th) that the preliminary October consumer confidence index fell from September’s 48.1 to 46.3, the lowest since May and below Reuters’ forecast of 47.8. The current conditions index dropped from 50.9 to 44.7, a historic low; the expectations index rose from 46.3 to 47.3, marking the first increase since July.

Consumers expect inflation over the next year to be 4.7%, up from September’s 4.6% and clearly higher than the 3.4% before the US‑Iran war began in February; long‑term inflation expectations for five to ten years rose from 3.4% to 3.5%, indicating price concerns remain.

Survey director Joanne Hsu said dissatisfaction with living costs continues to build, and consumers with low incomes and smaller stock‑investment positions lack the financial resources to cope with price hikes, leading to a sharp drop in confidence this month. Confidence among Democratic and Republican supporters rebounded but was offset by larger declines among independents.

She noted that despite political differences, consumers across all camps believe that, compared with the pre‑war situation at the start of the year, the economic outlook has weakened. Recent overall price increases have outpaced wage growth, further squeezing household budgets.

This month, consumers’ assessment of their current personal financial situation remained unchanged, while expectations for personal finances and the economy over the next year improved slightly, but high prices and high interest rates pushed durable‑goods purchase‑intention indicators to historic lows.

A special survey on the impact of high oil prices released the same day showed that only about 31% of respondents expect to maintain normal spending over the next year, while more than half plan to cut spending on household goods, automobiles, dining out or travel. Nevertheless, despite persistently low confidence this year, a stable job market and a strong stock market continue to support actual consumption.
The survey was conducted from September 22 to October 5.

items.title: Meta禁字節跳動投放廣告 涵蓋美加日韓越等7個市場
items.title_en: Meta bans ByteDance from advertising, covering US, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam
paras: Meta(META-US) 已禁止TikTok前控股股東字節跳動在美國等多個市場投放廣告，此舉意味著Meta與字節之間長期競爭進一步升級。
TikTok已成為Meta在爭奪用戶參與度、內容創作者和廣告收入方面最強勁的競爭對手之一。
據《彭博》9日（周五）報導，8日起Meta開始實施全面限制，禁止字節跳動在平台上投放廣告和付費營銷訊息。
Meta表示，該禁令將在美國、加拿大、埃及、印尼、日本、泰國和越南生效，同時也適用於在這些國家投放廣告、並將用戶引導至TikTok及字節跳動其他產品的第三方廣告客戶。
Meta發言人Chris Sgro在一份電子郵件聲明中表示：「我們沒有義務為一家旨在將用戶從我們應用上吸引走的競爭對手投放廣告。拒絕向競爭對手提供推廣服務，是各行各業正常商業做法。我們將繼續在產品品質和用戶體驗方面展開競爭。」
目前TikTok在美國以一家由美國投資者持股佔多數的合資企業營運，這項安排旨在保障美國用戶資料安全，並避免TikTok遭到美國政府封禁。TikTok在美國擁有超過2億名使用者。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Meta (META-US) has prohibited TikTok's former majority shareholder ByteDance from placing ads in the United States and several other markets, a move that signals an escalation in the long‑standing competition between Meta and ByteDance.
TikTok has become one of Meta's toughest rivals in the battle for user engagement, content creators and advertising revenue.
According to Bloomberg on Friday the 9th, Meta began enforcing a blanket restriction on the 8th, banning ByteDance from running ads and paid marketing messages on its platform.

Meta said the ban will take effect in the United States, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam, and will also apply to third‑party advertisers that run ads in those countries that direct users to TikTok or other ByteDance products.

Meta spokesperson Chris Sgro said in an email statement: “We have no obligation to place ads for a competitor whose goal is to pull users away from our apps. Refusing to provide promotional services to a rival is a normal business practice across industries. We will continue to compete on product quality and user experience.”

TikTok currently operates in the United States as a joint venture majority‑owned by U.S. investors, a structure intended to safeguard American user data and prevent a U.S. government ban. TikTok has over 200 million users in the U.S.
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 撤換Fed理事再出招！川普組調查小組 庫克律師嗆走過場
items.title_en: Trump Administration Moves Again to Oust Fed Governor Cook; Trump Team Investigates, Cook's Lawyer Calls It a Stunt
paras: 美國總統川普再度推進撤換聯準會(Fed)理事庫克(Lisa Cook)的行動，正式成立調查委員會，檢視她涉嫌在房貸文件中作出不實陳述的指控，並要求她於11月5日赴白宮出席不公開聽證會。庫克否認不法，其律師質疑程序合法性，但表示願意提出事實，證明沒有將她免職的法律依據。
綜合外媒報導，白宮周五(9日)公布一份日期為周三的總統備忘錄，要求委員會調查相關指控，並向川普報告，是否存在《聯邦準備法》所要求、足以撤換Fed理事的法定事由。聽證會安排在期中選舉後兩天，庫克可事先提交書面陳述，並由律師陪同出席。

白宮官員組成調查小組 庫克律師質疑程序公正性

委員會三名成員均來自行政部門，包括白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特(Kevin Hassett)、政府倫理局代理局長桑德林(Keith Sonderling)，以及公平就業機會委員會主席盧卡斯(Andrea Lucas)，未列入外部獨立人士。委員會可諮詢司法部及其他機關，協助調查。
川普在備忘錄中表示，總統有責任確保法律忠實執行，包括撤換無法被信任會誠實陳述及遵守法律的下屬。他長期要求Fed降息，近期更將自己提名的主席華許未能降息，歸咎於「充滿敵意」的理事會。
庫克的律師羅威爾(Abbe Lowell)與艾森(Norm Eisen)表示，川普已多次表明不論證據為何都要撤換庫克，因此對聽證會是否合法抱持重大疑慮。他們正與白宮接洽，確認程序是否具有實質意義，而非只是走過場。
律師強調，只要調查接近客觀，就會得出庫克未涉及房貸詐欺、沒有理由將她免職的結論。Fed則不予置評，請媒體洽詢庫克律師。

最高法院要求正當程序 免職事由仍是攻防核心

川普去年8月首度宣布撤換庫克，起因是聯邦住房金融局局長普爾特(Bill Pulte)指控她在貸款申請中說謊，以取得優惠條件。庫克隨即提告，否認指控，並主張相關指控不足以構成法定免職事由。
最高法院今年6月以5比4裁定，庫克可在訴訟期間留任，認為川普先前未給予充分通知及辯護機會，但未禁止白宮重新啟動程序。判決曾援引前總統塔虎脫1912年成立調查委員會的案例，卻未具體規定程序形式。
福坦莫大學法學教授曼納斯(Jane Manners)認為，川普此舉看似回應最高法院的程序要求，但法院對撤換Fed理事的事由設下高門檻，並強調央行應免於政治干預，這仍將是後續訴訟核心。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫批評，川普正透過不合法的「作秀審判」企圖控制央行。司法部與庫克律師預定11月6日、也就是聽證會隔天，向華府聯邦法官提交報告，說明原有訴訟的後續安排。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump is once again pushing to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, formally establishing an investigative committee to examine accusations that she made false statements in mortgage documents, and demanding she appear at a closed‑door hearing at the White House on November 5. Cook denies any wrongdoing, her lawyer questions the legality of the process, but says she will present facts to show there is no legal basis for her removal.

According to foreign media reports, the White House on Friday the 9th released a presidential memorandum dated Wednesday that orders the committee to investigate the allegations and report to Trump whether there are statutory grounds under the Federal Reserve Act sufficient to remove a Fed governor. The hearing is scheduled for two days after the midterm elections; Cook may submit a written statement in advance and be accompanied by counsel.

White House officials have formed the investigative panel, and Cook's lawyer has raised concerns about procedural fairness. All three committee members come from the executive branch: Kevin Hassett, director of the White House National Economic Council; Keith Sonderling, acting director of the Office of Government Ethics; and Andrea Lucas, chair of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. No external independent members were appointed. The committee may consult the Justice Department and other agencies for assistance.

In the memorandum, Trump wrote that the president has a duty to ensure faithful execution of the law, including removing subordinates who cannot be trusted to be honest and comply with the law. He has long pressed the Fed to cut rates, and recently blamed his own nominee for chair Wes Moore’s failure to cut rates on a "hostile" board of governors.

Cook's attorneys, Abbe Lowell and Norm Eisen, said Trump has repeatedly indicated he will fire Cook regardless of the evidence, raising serious doubts about the legality of the hearing. They are in talks with the White House to confirm whether the process has any substantive meaning or is merely a perfunctory exercise.

The lawyers emphasized that if the investigation is conducted objectively, it will conclude that Cook was not involved in mortgage fraud and there is no justification for her removal. The Fed declined to comment and directed media inquiries to Cook's counsel.

The Supreme Court has demanded due process, keeping the grounds for removal at the heart of the dispute. Trump first announced his intent to oust Cook in August last year after Federal Housing Finance Agency head Bill Pulte accused her of lying on loan applications to secure favorable terms. Cook promptly sued, denied the allegations, and argued the claims do not meet the statutory threshold for removal.

In June this year the Supreme Court ruled 5‑4 that Cook may remain in office during the litigation, finding that Trump had not provided adequate notice and an opportunity to defend, but it did not bar the White House from restarting the removal process. The decision cited a 1912 investigation committee established by former President Taft, but did not specify procedural details.

Law professor Jane Manners of Fordham University said Trump's move appears to respond to the Supreme Court's procedural demands, but the Court has set a high bar for grounds to remove a Fed governor and stressed that the central bank should be insulated from political interference, which will remain a key issue in future lawsuits.

Senate Banking Committee Democratic ranking member Sherrod Brown criticized Trump for attempting to control the central bank through an unlawful "show trial." The Justice Department and Cook's lawyers plan to file a report with a federal judge in Washington on November 6, the day after the hearing, outlining the next steps in the existing litigation.

items.title_en: Yahong Electronics' September Revenue Turns Positive, Gains Strength in H2 and Adds New Production Line in Taiwan
paras: 以專業代工電子專業音訊及保健器材開發服務爲主軸的亞弘電 (6201-TW)，今(2026)年訂單能見度不弱，下半年接單出貨轉強，帶動9月營收衝高到4.35億元，創68個月來新高，月增25.56%，年增59.54%，前 9 月營收26.17億元，與去年同期比較轉爲正成長，年增1.13%；亞弘電在台南也增設一條生產線，以因應需求的成長。
亞弘電第三季營收突破11億元，達11.09億元，季增36.9%，年增25.36%。
亞弘電下半年以來訂單明確，並有向第四季延伸的走勢，營收的成長主要因新機種驗貨、出貨順暢，同時，9月營收出現跳升，除8月出貨的遞延因素挹注之外，還有歐洲船期延長，部分客戶有提前出貨趨勢；同時，唱盤客戶訂單也有所增加
此外，亞弘電本季營運也有旺季效應加持。9、10月原本就是電子音訊產品的出貨旺季，主要受惠於客戶為因應萬聖節、感恩節及耶誕節等年末消費旺季，提前備貨、拉貨，帶動相關產品出貨需求。
亞弘電主管指出，因應客戶後續有部分新機種產品體積較大之需求，公司也已擴充好新產線設備準備生產。
亞弘電2026年上半年營收15.08億元，毛利率23.47%，稅後純益1.35億元，每股純益達1.52元。
paras_en: Yahong Electronics (6201‑TW), which focuses on professional contract manufacturing of electronic audio and health‑care devices, saw strong order visibility in 2026. In the second half of the year, orders and shipments picked up, pushing September revenue up to NT$4.35 billion – a 68‑month high – up 25.56% month‑over‑month and 59.54% year‑over‑year. Revenue for the first nine months reached NT$26.17 billion, turning positive versus the same period last year with a 1.13% annual increase. The company also added a new production line in Tainan to meet growing demand.
In the third quarter, Yahong Electronics’ revenue broke NT$11 billion, reaching NT$11.09 billion, up 36.9% sequentially and 25.36% year‑over‑year.

Orders have been clear since the second half of the year and are extending into the fourth quarter. Revenue growth was driven by new‑model inspections and smooth shipments. September’s revenue jump was aided not only by delayed shipments from August but also by extended European vessel schedules, prompting some customers to ship earlier; orders from disc‑player customers also increased.

In addition, the quarter benefited from seasonal demand. September and October are traditionally peak months for electronic audio product shipments, as customers stock up ahead of the Halloween, Thanksgiving and Christmas shopping season, boosting demand for related products.
A company executive noted that, because some upcoming new‑model products have larger volumes, the firm has already expanded its new production‑line equipment to prepare for manufacturing them.
For the first half of 2026, Yahong Electronics reported revenue of NT$15.08 billion, a gross margin of 23.47%, net profit after tax of NT$1.35 billion, and earnings per share of NT$1.52.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉巧新營收創高 切入半導體設備供應鏈 股價挑戰前高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Qiao Xin Posts Record Revenue, Moves Into Semiconductor Equipment Supply Chain, Stock Tests Prior Highs
paras: 全球汽車輪圈領導廠商巧新(1563-TW)公布9月合併營收8.16億元，月增48.45%、年增39.69%，創單月新高紀錄，本周股價也再度見到8字頭，逼近9月7日現金減資25%前價位；市場已開始關注巧新切入半導體新領域的進程，巧新回應，第四季後以半導體設備關鍵零組件為非車用事業的重要發展方向。
巧新指出，切入半導體前段設備(CVD/PVD、蝕刻)腔體的相關零組件領域，目前已完成與國際客戶合作產品驗證，並進入試量產階段，預期將堆疊新一波營運成長動能。
巧新第三季合併營收達20.16億元，季增1.83%，年增18.48%，前三季合併營收58.68億元，年增9.99%， 9月營收強勁主要受惠於歐美超跑、豪華車品牌客戶需求持續回溫，隨著第三季歐美車廠例行性暑休告一段落，主要客戶陸續恢復正常生產及拉貨節奏，帶動客製化鍛造鋁合金輪圈出貨動能提升。
除既有車用本業持續穩健成長外，投資人開始關注巧新切入半導體市場的時程。
巧新指出，正開拓非車用事業第二成長曲線，面對全球半導體產業持續擴大先進製程投資，以及設備供應鏈對高品質、低碳材料和在地化供應的需求，切入半導體前段設備(CVD/PVD、蝕刻)腔體相關零組件領域，完成與國際客戶合作進行產品驗證，並進入試量產。
進入第四季後，巧新以半導體設備關鍵零組件為非車用事業的重要發展方向，加速推動再生鋁相關應用產品驗證及量產導入，拓展國際半導體供應鏈合作機會。
而巧新屏東新熔煉廠正依建廠計畫推進工程建置、設備導入和後續試車驗證，預計於2027年第三季逐步量產。
paras_en: Qiao Xin (1563‑TW), a global leader in automotive wheels, reported September consolidated revenue of NT$8.16 billion, up 48.45% month‑over‑month and 39.69% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑month record. This week its share price again rose into the 8‑yuan range, approaching the pre‑capital‑reduction level of September 7. The market is now watching the company’s progress in entering the semiconductor arena, and Qiao Xin responded that after the fourth quarter it will make key semiconductor‑equipment components a major growth direction outside its automotive business.

Qiao Xin noted that its entry into front‑end semiconductor equipment (CVD/PVD, etching) chamber components has already completed product verification with international customers and entered a trial‑production stage, which is expected to generate a new wave of operational growth momentum.

In the third quarter, Qiao Xin’s consolidated revenue reached NT$20.16 billion, up 1.83% sequentially and 18.48% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$58.68 billion, a 9.99% annual increase. The strong September performance was mainly driven by renewed demand from European and American super‑car and luxury‑vehicle customers. As the routine summer shutdowns at European and American automakers ended, major clients resumed normal production and shipping schedules, boosting shipments of customized forged‑aluminum alloy wheels.
Beyond its steady growth in the automotive core business, investors are beginning to focus on the timeline for Qiao Xin’s entry into the semiconductor market.

Qiao Xin said it is developing a second growth curve outside the automotive sector. Facing the global semiconductor industry’s continued expansion of advanced‑process investments and the supply‑chain demand for high‑quality, low‑carbon materials and localized sourcing, the company is targeting front‑end semiconductor equipment (CVD/PVD, etching) chamber components. It has completed product verification with international customers and moved into trial production.

After entering the fourth quarter, Qiao Xin will prioritize key semiconductor‑equipment components as a major development direction for its non‑automotive business, accelerating validation and mass‑production of recycled‑aluminum‑based applications and expanding cooperation opportunities within the international semiconductor supply chain.

Qiao Xin’s new smelting plant in Pingtung is progressing according to its construction plan, with engineering, equipment installation, and subsequent test‑run verification underway, and is slated to begin phased mass production in the third quarter of 2027.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉融程電9月營收衝高+明年展望樂觀 股價站回季線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Rongcheng Electronics September Revenue Soars + Optimistic Outlook for Next Year, Stock Returns to Quarterly Line
paras: 工業電腦廠融程電(3416-TW)9月營收衝上5.34億元，創單月新高，月增31.8%、年增95.9%，加上明年展望樂觀，激勵周四股價跳空大漲，一度逼近漲停，收盤仍漲逾7%，來到182元站回季線、半年線之上。
融程電前9月累計營收35.36億元，年增34.2%，同步改寫歷史新高，主要受惠國防軍工、半導體及邊緣AI市場終端需求強勁接單暢旺，明年整體營運將再創新高。
融程電表示，因應不同市場需求調整出貨及生產配置，邊緣AI、國防軍工應用成長預估至少5成，推出國防軍工無人機與機器人應用的強固型邊緣AI平台，搶攻國防軍工、船舶海事電腦、智慧製造、智慧醫療、物流到智慧城市等應用擴展全球產業鏈。
展望後市，持續強化在美國、韓國、日本生產組裝行銷，Key Account 佈局，與加快歐洲的整合，並與主要供應商建立長期策略合作關係，確保關鍵料件供應穩定，持續進一步深化國防軍工、半導體及邊緣運算市場。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Rongcheng Electronics (3416-TW) posted September revenue of NT$5.34 billion, a monthly record, up 31.8% month‑on‑month and 95.9% year‑on‑year. With an optimistic outlook for next year, the stock jumped on Thursday, briefly approaching the daily limit up, and closed up more than 7% at NT$182, back above the quarterly and half‑year moving averages.

Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$35.36 billion, a 34.2% year‑over‑year increase, setting a new historical high. The growth was driven by strong demand and orders from defense & military, semiconductor and edge‑AI markets, and the company expects overall operations to hit another record next year.

Rongcheng Electronics said it is adjusting shipments and production allocations to meet different market needs; it forecasts at least a 50% growth for edge‑AI and defense‑military applications, and is launching a rugged edge‑AI platform for defense drones and robotics, targeting defense‑military, ship‑board maritime computers, smart manufacturing, smart healthcare, logistics and smart city applications to expand its global supply chain.

Looking ahead, the firm will continue to strengthen production, assembly and marketing in the United States, South Korea and Japan, expand its key‑account layout, accelerate integration in Europe, and establish long‑term strategic partnerships with major suppliers to ensure stable supply of critical components, further deepening its presence in defense‑military, semiconductor and edge‑computing markets.

items.title: 南僑成T+T+A三掛牌集團 整合資源強攻東協食品、烘焙商機
items.title_en: Nanqiao T+T+A Triple-Listed Group Integrates Resources to Aggressively Target ASEAN Food and Bakery Opportunities
paras: 南僑(1702-TW)集團包括上海南僑食品(605339-SH)、皇家可口(7791-TW)爲少數T+T+A的兩岸三掛牌集團，南僑董事長陳正文今(9)日指出，東南亞的東協市場實為潛力極大的市場，上海南僑食品已在泰國設立NFB子公司，同時，皇家可口也有在當地的開發、拓銷計畫。
在集團資源的整合下，南僑持續在東協此一成長性高的市場布局，陳正文指出，對此一市場的整合行銷相當一致。
南僑在泰國投資生產事業已經30年，在泰國投資第四條及第五條生產線都已全部正式量產，營收從2019年以來維持6%以上的複合成長率，而到2025年達42.5億泰銖、年成長58%。泰國南僑營收有81%來自米製品，預計2026年要把市場再擴大，朝更創新及更功能化產品邁進，陸續開發與推出新產品。
皇家可口在台灣的急凍熟麵第三條生產線已正式投產，董事長周明芬表示，未來將在集團資源整合與挹注下，進一步拓展市場版圖，除深耕台灣市場外，也將泰國及其他國際市場列為開發重點。此外，即食產品的市場拓展，以及與通路業者建立合作關係，也將是公司未來重要的營運策略。
上海南僑食品主力產品包括油脂、冷凍麵糰及預製烘焙等產品，在泰國成立子公司已經達2年，並設立烘焙展示中心，包括進一步開發泰國極度國際化的餐飲及餐飲市場，成效已逐漸顯現。
南僑董事長陳正文指出，烘焙事業已在印尼、馬來西亞設立子公司，在泰國烘焙展示中心設立後，印尼、馬來西亞預計也將循此一模式進一步進行東協市場的深度開發。
paras_en: Nanqiao (1702-TW) Group, which includes Shanghai Nanqiao Food (605339-SH) and Royal Kuo (7791-TW), is one of the few cross‑strait T+T+A triple‑listed groups. Chairman Chen Zhengwen said today (the 9th) that the ASEAN market in Southeast Asia holds huge potential. Shanghai Nanqiao Food has already set up an NFB subsidiary in Thailand, and Royal Kuo also has development and sales plans in the region.

With the integration of group resources, Nanqiao continues to lay out its strategy in the high‑growth ASEAN market. Chen Zhengwen noted that the integrated marketing approach for this market is highly consistent.

Nanqiao has been investing in production in Thailand for 30 years. The fourth and fifth production lines have both entered full‑scale mass production, and revenue has maintained a compound annual growth rate of over 6% since 2019. Revenue is projected to reach 4.25 billion baht by 2025, a 58% year‑on‑year increase. About 81% of Thai Nanqiao’s revenue comes from rice‑based products, and the company aims to further expand the market in 2026, moving toward more innovative and functional products while continuously developing and launching new items.

Royal Kuo’s third frozen cooked‑noodle production line in Taiwan has officially started operation. Chairman Zhou Mingfen said that, leveraging the group’s integrated resources and capital, the company will further expand its market footprint. In addition to deepening its presence in Taiwan, Thailand and other international markets are also key development targets. Moreover, expanding the ready‑to‑eat product line and building partnerships with channel partners will be important operational strategies going forward.

Shanghai Nanqiao Food’s core products include oils, frozen dough and ready‑made bakery items. Its Thai subsidiary, established two years ago, has set up a bakery demonstration centre and is further developing Thailand’s highly internationalised foodservice market, with results beginning to show.

Chairman Chen Zhengwen said the bakery business has already established subsidiaries in Indonesia and Malaysia. After the bakery demonstration centre was set up in Thailand, the subsidiaries in Indonesia and Malaysia are expected to follow the same model to deepen development across the ASEAN market.

items.title: 高明鐵9月、Q3營收創新高 單季營收6.51億元超越去年全年
items.title_en: Gaoming Iron September, Q3 Revenue Sets New High; Quarterly Revenue 6.51 Billion Beats Full-Year 2025
paras: 受惠 AI 資料中心建置加速、高速光通訊升級，以及高精密耦合自動化設備需求持續升溫，由鏡頭組裝轉型為光通訊耦光工站的高明鐵 (4573-TW)，今(9)日公布最新營收，9月再創新高，第三季營收6.51億元同創新高，單季營收更是超越去 (2025) 年全年營收。
高明鐵2026年9月營收2.3億元，月增4.7%，年增3.36倍，第三季單季營收6.51億元，超越2025年全年6.03億元，季增44.31%、年增3.24倍，累計1-9月營收13.54億元，年增2.07倍。
高明鐵2026年上半年財報營收7.03億元，毛利率39.35%，年增16.71個百分點，稅後純益1.21億元，較去年轉盈，超越歷年全年獲利，每股純益達2.9元。法人預估高明鐵下半年營收及獲利大幅優於上半年，也等於是 2026 年業績將較去年倍數成長。
高明鐵通過全球前 10 大光通訊品牌廠認證，取得 800G 及 1.6T 耦光對位產品訂單，同時切入 CPO 封裝測試及 FAU＋MLA 精密組裝市場的龐大商機。
已加入矽光子聯盟的高明鐵，2026 年以來營運規模持續增強，在 AI 高速傳輸與光通訊設備領域的接單與出貨動能持續升溫。同時，高明鐵 4000 張現增股，以每股 325 元溢價發行，已完成募集 13 億元資金。
高明鐵董事長陳志鑫指出，本次增資順利完成，代表資本市場對高明鐵轉型矽光子設備事業的肯定。高明鐵將以精密運動控制數十年累積的技術底蘊，結合 AI 對位演算法，成為 CPO 產業鏈中不可或缺的光耦合解決方案供應商。
paras_en: Benefiting from accelerated AI data‑center construction, upgrades to high‑speed optical communications, and rising demand for high‑precision coupled automation equipment, Gaoming Iron (4573‑TW), which has shifted from lens assembly to optical‑communication coupling workstations, announced today that September’s revenue hit a new peak and Q3 revenue reached NT$6.51 billion, also a record, with the single‑quarter revenue surpassing the entire 2025 full‑year figure.

Gaoming Iron posted NT$2.3 billion in September 2026, up 4.7% month‑over‑month and 3.36‑fold year‑over‑year. Q3 single‑quarter revenue was NT$6.51 billion, exceeding the full‑year 2025 revenue of NT$6.03 billion, a 44.31% quarterly increase and 3.24‑fold annual increase. Cumulative revenue for January‑September reached NT$13.54 billion, up 2.07‑fold year‑over‑year.

In the first half of 2026, Gaoming Iron reported revenue of NT$7.03 billion with a gross margin of 39.35%, an increase of 16.71 percentage points year‑over‑year, and a post‑tax profit of NT$1.21 billion, turning profitable compared with the prior year and surpassing any full‑year profit in its history. Earnings per share reached NT$2.9. Analysts forecast that the second‑half revenue and profit will far outpace the first half, implying that 2026 results will grow multiple times over the previous year.

Gaoming Iron obtained certification from the world’s top‑10 optical‑communication brand manufacturers, securing orders for 800 G and 1.6 T optical‑coupling alignment products, and simultaneously entered the large‑scale opportunities in CPO packaging testing and FAU + MLA precision assembly markets.

Having joined the Silicon Photonics Alliance, Gaoming Iron’s operating scale has continuously expanded since 2026, with order and shipment momentum in AI high‑speed transmission and optical‑communication equipment remaining strong. In addition, the company issued 4,000 new shares at a premium of NT$325 per share, raising NT$1.3 billion.

Chairman Chen Zhixin said the successful capital increase reflects the market’s confidence in Gaoming Iron’s transition to silicon‑photonics equipment. The company will leverage decades of precision motion‑control technology combined with AI alignment algorithms to become an indispensable optical‑coupling solution provider in the CPO industry chain.

items.title: 當AI房東穩賺？華爾街熱推資料中心 風險卻愈堆愈高
items.title_en: When AI Landlords Seem Surefire? Wall Street Pushes Data Centers, but Risks Keep Mounting
paras: AI熱潮帶動資料中心投資，華爾街正將這類基礎設施包裝成房地產配置選項，吸引投資人分享數位經濟成長。然而，從股價下跌、地方反對聲浪，到電力供應與資金流動性限制，風險也逐漸浮現，顯示資料中心並非只要搭上AI商機，就能穩賺租金。
據《CNBC》報導，這類投資目前仍以退休基金等機構法人為主，但黑石集團(BX-US)、藍鴞資本(Blue Owl)(OWL-US)等另類資產管理業者，正透過上市不動產投資信託(REIT)等方式，擴大投資人參與管道。

華爾街搶推資料中心投資 上市表現未必跟上AI熱潮

黑石今年推出Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust(BXDC-US)，鎖定北維吉尼亞、達拉斯等成熟市場的既有資料中心。執行長佩爾(Nick Pell)認為，相較於開發新案，投資營運成熟的設施風險較低，未來數年潛在市場規模可望突破1兆美元。
不過，該REIT於5月中旬以每股20美元發行8,750萬股，周四收盤已跌破17美元，較發行價下跌約16%，且目前尚未投入資金進行投資。資料中心REIT業者Equinix(EQIX-US)與Digital Realty Trust(DLR-US)長期表現雖佳，同期股價也陷入停滯。
藍鴞資本則傳出考慮將既有資料中心投資整合為上市REIT，估值最高65億美元。公司表示，在全球32個市場擁有逾130座資料中心，資產超過180億美元，並強調租約設有保障，即使租戶提前退出，也能取得補償。
然而，利率與美債殖利率上升會提高融資成本，也削弱收息型資產的吸引力。REIT今年漲幅多集中在債市壓力加劇前，8月以來已有不少相關投資遭到拋售。

地方反彈與電力瓶頸升溫 長約難擋所有開發風險

政治阻力也在擴大。蓋洛普調查顯示，70%美國民眾反對在住家附近興建資料中心。紐約州7月暫停核准新的超大規模資料中心，德州8月跟進，讓投資人必須重新評估許可延誤對預期報酬的影響。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)9月底針對新墨西哥州、由藍鴞資本開發的Project Jupiter資料中心園區發出不可抗力通知，若計畫未能於2028年投入營運，尋求延後付款，理由包括監管障礙與地方反對。儘管公司表示進度仍符合計畫，消息仍拖累股價下跌4%。
蓋茨堡學院財務教授莫拉(Sabur Mollah)指出，雲端、AI與資料儲存需求，確實可支撐資料中心長期發展，優質設施與大型科技公司簽訂長約，也有助取得穩定租金。
但這類資產需要龐大資本，仰賴可靠的電力、冷卻與網路設施，另有估值過高、租戶集中、技術過時、再融資及持續維護支出等風險。天災或設備停機，也可能讓業者無法履行服務承諾，保險只能協助分攤部分損失。

散戶參與管道增加 私募基金贖回限制須看清

目前散戶參與仍有限，黑石這檔上市REIT約94%由機構持有。不過，美國證券交易委員會(SEC)主席阿特金斯(Paul Atkins)近期提出擴大散戶參與私募投資的方案，相關產品未來可能更加普及。
投資人尤其需要區分上市REIT與私募基金。前者可在交易所買賣，後者可能設有贖回窗口及額度限制，能買進不代表隨時能取回資金。InvestCloud主管塔弗(Andrew Tarver)指出，私募市場原本是為少數機構的大額、低頻交易設計，未必適合大量散戶頻繁進出。
財富顧問法爾肯(Jake Falcon)認為，資料中心基金可作為小比例、長期配置，但投資前仍須確認是否符合資金用途與整體目標，並充分理解產品結構，不能只因AI題材熱門就貿然投入。
paras_en: The AI boom is driving data‑center investment, and Wall Street is packaging this infrastructure as a real‑estate allocation option to let investors share in the digital‑economy growth. Yet risks are emerging—from falling stock prices and local opposition to power‑supply constraints and liquidity limits—showing that data centers aren’t a guaranteed rent‑check just because they ride the AI wave.

According to CNBC, most of this capital currently comes from institutional investors such as pension funds, but alternative‑asset managers like Blackstone (BX‑US) and Blue Owl (OWL‑US) are expanding investor access through publicly listed REITs.

Wall Street is aggressively promoting data‑center investments, but listed performance may not keep pace with the AI hype. Blackstone launched the Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust (BXDC‑US) this year, targeting existing data‑center assets in mature markets such as Northern Virginia and Dallas. CEO Nick Pell argues that buying and operating mature facilities carries lower risk than greenfield development, and the market could exceed $1 trillion in the next few years.

However, the REIT issued 87.5 million shares at $20 each in mid‑May and closed Thursday below $17, about a 16% discount to the IPO price, and it has yet to deploy any capital. While data‑center REITs like Equinix (EQIX‑US) and Digital Realty Trust (DLR‑US) have performed well over the long term, their stock prices have also stalled recently.

Blue Owl is reportedly considering bundling its existing data‑center holdings into a listed REIT, with a valuation that could reach $6.5 billion. The firm says it operates more than 130 data centers across 32 markets, with assets over $18 billion, and stresses that leases are protected so that even if a tenant exits early, compensation is secured.

Rising interest rates and U.S. Treasury yields increase financing costs and diminish the appeal of yield‑focused assets. REIT gains this year were largely concentrated before bond‑market pressure intensified, and many related positions have been sold off since August.

Local backlash and power‑supply bottlenecks are adding to development risk. A Gallup poll shows 70% of Americans oppose building data centers near residential areas. New York halted approvals for new hyperscale data centers in July, and Texas followed in August, forcing investors to reassess the impact of permitting delays on expected returns.

Oracle (ORCL‑US) issued a force‑majeure notice at the end of September for the Project Jupiter data‑center campus in New Mexico, being developed by Blue Owl. If the project cannot be operational by 2028, Oracle will seek delayed payments, citing regulatory hurdles and local opposition. Although the company says the schedule remains on track, the news dragged the stock down 4%.

Finance professor Sabur Mollah of Gatesburg College notes that cloud, AI and data‑storage demand can indeed sustain long‑term data‑center growth; high‑quality facilities with long‑term contracts from large tech firms help secure stable rent streams.

But these assets require massive capital, reliable power, cooling and network infrastructure, and face risks such as overvaluation, tenant concentration, technological obsolescence, refinancing needs and ongoing maintenance costs. Natural disasters or equipment failures could prevent operators from meeting service commitments, with insurance only covering part of the loss.

Retail investor participation remains limited; about 94% of Blackstone’s listed REIT is held by institutions. However, SEC Chair Paul Atkins has recently proposed expanding retail access to private‑investment products, which could make such offerings more common in the future.

Investors need to distinguish between listed REITs and private funds. The former trade on exchanges, while the latter may have redemption windows and caps, meaning buying does not guarantee immediate cash‑out. Andrew Tarver of InvestCloud points out that the private market was designed for a few institutions’ large, low‑frequency trades and may not suit frequent retail turnover.

Wealth advisor Jake Falcon says data‑center funds can be a small‑percentage, long‑term allocation, but investors should verify that they fit their liquidity needs and overall objectives and fully understand the product structure, rather than jumping in simply because AI is trendy.

items.title: 美債還沒跌完？四大警訊浮現 殖利率恐再衝高
items.title_en: U.S. Treasuries Still Not Fully Fallen? Four Major Warning Signs Emerge, Yields May Surge Again
paras: 美債殖利率攀抵逾20年高點，市場擔心賣壓可能愈演愈烈。從利率選擇權避險需求升溫、AI企業大舉發債，到房貸資產避險與長天期公債承壓，四項訊號顯示，債市拋售可能形成連鎖反應，進一步推高殖利率。
據《路透》報導，自2月美伊戰爭爆發以來，10年期美債殖利率累計上升約135個基點至5.23%；30年期殖利率則自3月低點上升約110個基點至5.614%，雙雙來到20多年前才見過的水準。
不過，高殖利率也可能吸引買盤，讓投資人鎖定小布希執政以來少見的收益水準。市場目前關注的是，這股承接力能否抵銷避險交易與資金調整所帶來的額外賣壓。

利率避險需求升溫 市場防範殖利率再衝高

第一項警訊來自利率選擇權。投資人正加碼防範利率上升的保護性部位，希望在不出售美債持倉的情況下，降低殖利率急升造成的損失。
針對未來三個月10年期美元利率交換利率上升200個基點的避險需求明顯增加，相關保護成本周一升至132個基點，創2023年3月矽谷銀行倒閉引發銀行危機以來最高。
利率交換是以固定利率交換浮動利率的契約。雖然這類選擇權連結的是交換利率，而非美債殖利率，但兩者通常同向變動，因此防範利率上漲的選擇權相對昂貴，反映市場對長期美債殖利率續升的擔憂。
此外，10年期利率交換的一個月期選擇權隱含波動率升至21.4個基點，創3月底以來最高，顯示市場對長期利率走勢的不確定性增加。

AI發債與房貸避險交織 美債承受額外賣壓

第二項壓力來自AI基礎建設融資。大型科技業者為擴建資料中心等設施，持續發行公司債。雖然信用利差仍低，但買進這些長天期債券的投資人，會透過賣出美債期貨，降低投資組合對利率上升的敏感度。
RBC BlueBay Asset Management投資組合經理Neil Sun表示，公司債交易中午定價後，下午往往就出現大量美債期貨賣單。部分投資人則直接出售美債，騰出資金買進收益率較高的投資等級公司債。
高盛(GS-US)預估，大型雲端與AI業者明年發債規模可能達創紀錄的4,200億美元，意味相關避險或美債出售需求可能持續增加。
第三項警訊是房貸資產避險加速。利率上升時，借款人提前還款或轉貸的意願下降，房貸抵押證券(MBS)的預期存續期間因而拉長，也更容易受到利率進一步上升的衝擊。
投資人通常會增加利率避險，包括賣出美債期貨，抵銷這種新增風險。這類「凸性避險」可能形成循環：殖利率愈升，避險賣盤愈多，又進一步加重債市壓力。
Eris Innovations執行長Mike Riddle指出，過去三年承作的房貸中，有相當大一部分票面利率接近目前房貸利率，因此可能引發更多避險需求，本月九筆大型交易已顯示投資人積極保護部位。

長債殖利率升得更快 財政疑慮推高持債補償

第四項訊號是10年期與30年期美債殖利率差距再度擴大。本周兩者利差約37個基點，反映30年期殖利率上升速度更快，投資人要求更高報酬，才願意持有最長天期公債。
這項利差雖仍低於7月底的52個基點，但目前殖利率已接近數十年高點，顯示市場變化愈來愈反映「期限溢價」上升，也就是持有長期債券所要求的額外補償，而不只是重新評估聯準會(Fed)利率政策。
F/m Investments共同創辦人Alex Morris表示，投資人對10年期美債的興趣高於30年期，因為時間拉長，美國財政出問題的可能性也更令人擔憂。這反映市場對政府能否掌控長期財政局勢，仍缺乏信心。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have climbed to over‑20‑year highs, prompting market fears that selling pressure could intensify. From rising demand for interest‑rate option hedges and a wave of AI‑company bond issuances to mortgage‑asset hedging and pressure on long‑dated sovereign bonds, four signals suggest a bond‑market sell‑off could trigger a chain reaction that pushes yields higher.

According to Reuters, since the outbreak of the U.S.–Iran war in February, the 10‑year Treasury yield has risen about 135 basis points to 5.23%, while the 30‑year yield has climbed roughly 110 basis points since its March low to 5.614%, both levels last seen more than two decades ago.

However, high yields could also attract buyers, allowing investors to lock in a return level rarely seen since the Bush administration. The market is now watching whether this buying strength can offset the extra selling pressure generated by hedging trades and fund reallocations.

Rising demand for rate hedges signals market concerns that yields could climb further. The first warning comes from interest‑rate options, as investors increase protective positions against rising rates, hoping to limit losses from a rapid yield surge without having to sell Treasury holdings.

Hedging demand for a 200‑basis‑point rise in the 10‑year USD interest‑rate swap over the next three months has surged, pushing the related protection cost up to 132 basis points on Monday – the highest since the March 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse triggered a banking crisis.

An interest‑rate swap is a contract that exchanges a fixed rate for a floating rate. Although these options are linked to swap rates rather than Treasury yields, the two usually move in tandem, making rate‑rise protection relatively expensive and reflecting market worries that long‑term Treasury yields will keep climbing.

In addition, the one‑month implied volatility of the 10‑year swap option rose to 21.4 basis points, the highest since the end of March, indicating growing uncertainty about the trajectory of long‑term rates.

AI‑driven financing adds a second pressure. Large tech firms are continuously issuing corporate bonds to fund data‑center expansions and other infrastructure. While credit spreads remain low, investors buying these long‑dated bonds often hedge by selling Treasury futures to reduce portfolio sensitivity to rising rates.

Neil Sun, portfolio manager at RBC BlueBay Asset Management, said that after corporate‑bond pricing settles at midday, a flood of Treasury‑future sell orders typically appears in the afternoon. Some investors even sell Treasuries outright to free up cash for higher‑yielding investment‑grade corporate debt.
Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) estimates that large cloud and AI companies could issue a record $420 billion in bonds next year, meaning hedging or Treasury‑selling demand could stay elevated.

The third warning is accelerating mortgage‑asset hedging. When rates rise, borrowers are less likely to prepay or refinance, extending the expected life of mortgage‑backed securities (MBS) and making them more vulnerable to further rate hikes.

Investors usually increase rate hedges, including selling Treasury futures, to offset this added risk. Such “convexity hedging” can become a feedback loop: higher yields spur more hedge‑sell orders, which in turn adds pressure to the bond market.

Mike Riddle, CEO of Eris Innovations, noted that a large portion of the mortgages originated over the past three years carry coupon rates close to current mortgage rates, potentially spurring more hedging demand; nine large deals this month already show investors actively protecting their positions.

The fourth signal is a widening spread between 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields. This week the spread is about 37 basis points, reflecting faster gains in the 30‑year yield and investors demanding higher compensation to hold the longest‑dated sovereign debt.

Although the spread remains below the 52‑basis‑point gap seen at the end of July, yields are now near multi‑decade highs, indicating the market is increasingly pricing in a higher term premium – extra compensation for holding long‑dated bonds beyond just reassessing the Fed’s policy stance.

Alex Morris, co‑founder of F/m Investments, said investors favor the 10‑year over the 30‑year because the longer horizon raises concerns about U.S. fiscal stability. This reflects lingering doubts about the government’s ability to manage long‑term fiscal risks.

items.title: 撤換Fed理事再出招！川普組調查小組 庫克律師嗆走過場
items.title_en: Trump Administration Moves Again to Oust Fed Governor Cook; Trump Team Investigates, Cook's Lawyer Calls It a Stunt
paras: 美國總統川普再度推進撤換聯準會(Fed)理事庫克(Lisa Cook)的行動，正式成立調查委員會，檢視她涉嫌在房貸文件中作出不實陳述的指控，並要求她於11月5日赴白宮出席不公開聽證會。庫克否認不法，其律師質疑程序合法性，但表示願意提出事實，證明沒有將她免職的法律依據。
綜合外媒報導，白宮周五(9日)公布一份日期為周三的總統備忘錄，要求委員會調查相關指控，並向川普報告，是否存在《聯邦準備法》所要求、足以撤換Fed理事的法定事由。聽證會安排在期中選舉後兩天，庫克可事先提交書面陳述，並由律師陪同出席。

白宮官員組成調查小組 庫克律師質疑程序公正性

委員會三名成員均來自行政部門，包括白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特(Kevin Hassett)、政府倫理局代理局長桑德林(Keith Sonderling)，以及公平就業機會委員會主席盧卡斯(Andrea Lucas)，未列入外部獨立人士。委員會可諮詢司法部及其他機關，協助調查。
川普在備忘錄中表示，總統有責任確保法律忠實執行，包括撤換無法被信任會誠實陳述及遵守法律的下屬。他長期要求Fed降息，近期更將自己提名的主席華許未能降息，歸咎於「充滿敵意」的理事會。
庫克的律師羅威爾(Abbe Lowell)與艾森(Norm Eisen)表示，川普已多次表明不論證據為何都要撤換庫克，因此對聽證會是否合法抱持重大疑慮。他們正與白宮接洽，確認程序是否具有實質意義，而非只是走過場。
律師強調，只要調查接近客觀，就會得出庫克未涉及房貸詐欺、沒有理由將她免職的結論。Fed則不予置評，請媒體洽詢庫克律師。

最高法院要求正當程序 免職事由仍是攻防核心

川普去年8月首度宣布撤換庫克，起因是聯邦住房金融局局長普爾特(Bill Pulte)指控她在貸款申請中說謊，以取得優惠條件。庫克隨即提告，否認指控，並主張相關指控不足以構成法定免職事由。
最高法院今年6月以5比4裁定，庫克可在訴訟期間留任，認為川普先前未給予充分通知及辯護機會，但未禁止白宮重新啟動程序。判決曾援引前總統塔虎脫1912年成立調查委員會的案例，卻未具體規定程序形式。
福坦莫大學法學教授曼納斯(Jane Manners)認為，川普此舉看似回應最高法院的程序要求，但法院對撤換Fed理事的事由設下高門檻，並強調央行應免於政治干預，這仍將是後續訴訟核心。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫批評，川普正透過不合法的「作秀審判」企圖控制央行。司法部與庫克律師預定11月6日、也就是聽證會隔天，向華府聯邦法官提交報告，說明原有訴訟的後續安排。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump is once again pushing to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, formally establishing an investigative committee to examine accusations that she made false statements in mortgage documents, and demanding she appear at a closed‑door hearing at the White House on November 5. Cook denies any wrongdoing, her lawyer questions the legality of the process, but says she will present facts to show there is no legal basis for her removal.

According to foreign media reports, the White House on Friday the 9th released a presidential memorandum dated Wednesday that orders the committee to investigate the allegations and report to Trump whether there are statutory grounds under the Federal Reserve Act sufficient to remove a Fed governor. The hearing is scheduled for two days after the midterm elections; Cook may submit a written statement in advance and be accompanied by counsel.

White House officials have formed the investigative panel, and Cook's lawyer has raised concerns about procedural fairness. All three committee members come from the executive branch: Kevin Hassett, director of the White House National Economic Council; Keith Sonderling, acting director of the Office of Government Ethics; and Andrea Lucas, chair of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. No external independent members were appointed. The committee may consult the Justice Department and other agencies for assistance.

In the memorandum, Trump wrote that the president has a duty to ensure faithful execution of the law, including removing subordinates who cannot be trusted to be honest and comply with the law. He has long pressed the Fed to cut rates, and recently blamed his own nominee for chair Wes Moore’s failure to cut rates on a "hostile" board of governors.

Cook's attorneys, Abbe Lowell and Norm Eisen, said Trump has repeatedly indicated he will fire Cook regardless of the evidence, raising serious doubts about the legality of the hearing. They are in talks with the White House to confirm whether the process has any substantive meaning or is merely a perfunctory exercise.

The lawyers emphasized that if the investigation is conducted objectively, it will conclude that Cook was not involved in mortgage fraud and there is no justification for her removal. The Fed declined to comment and directed media inquiries to Cook's counsel.

The Supreme Court has demanded due process, keeping the grounds for removal at the heart of the dispute. Trump first announced his intent to oust Cook in August last year after Federal Housing Finance Agency head Bill Pulte accused her of lying on loan applications to secure favorable terms. Cook promptly sued, denied the allegations, and argued the claims do not meet the statutory threshold for removal.

In June this year the Supreme Court ruled 5‑4 that Cook may remain in office during the litigation, finding that Trump had not provided adequate notice and an opportunity to defend, but it did not bar the White House from restarting the removal process. The decision cited a 1912 investigation committee established by former President Taft, but did not specify procedural details.

Law professor Jane Manners of Fordham University said Trump's move appears to respond to the Supreme Court's procedural demands, but the Court has set a high bar for grounds to remove a Fed governor and stressed that the central bank should be insulated from political interference, which will remain a key issue in future lawsuits.

Senate Banking Committee Democratic ranking member Sherrod Brown criticized Trump for attempting to control the central bank through an unlawful "show trial." The Justice Department and Cook's lawyers plan to file a report with a federal judge in Washington on November 6, the day after the hearing, outlining the next steps in the existing litigation.

items.title: AI需求看不到盡頭 Lumentum：光學元件訂單滿到2029年 部分產品缺口達七成
items.title_en: AI Demand Shows No End in Sight Lumentum: Optical Component Orders Booked Through 2029, Some Products Face a 70% Shortfall
paras: Lumentum Holdings(LITE-US)執行長Michael Hurlston周五(9日)表示，由於科技業爭相興建更高速的人工智慧(AI)資料中心，該公司接下來到2029年初的光學元件產能已被「預訂一空」。
Hurlston在東京受訪時表示，該公司部分產品從現在一直到明年的需求，將有約七成無法滿足，其他一些產品的需求缺口，甚至到2028年仍有三成無法供應。僅僅六個月前，Hurlston曾表示，Lumentum產能要到2028年才會售罄。
Lumentum與同業Coherent(COHR-US)今年稍早各自獲得輝達(NVDA-US)20億美元投資。Lumentum供應先進磷化銦元件，協助實現高速雲端運算與資料傳輸。分析師預期，Lumentum今年營收將較去年成長逾一倍。
Hurlston說：「我們真的在努力迎頭趕上，盡可能快速擴充產能，但與客戶的需求相比，我們仍落後非常、非常多。產能已經全部售罄，因此看不到需求何時才會出現盡頭。」

AI基建需求強 供應商擴產仍追不上

隨著全球大舉興建資料中心及其他AI基礎設施，部分投資人開始對隨之而來的成本上升與債務膨脹更加謹慎。為了緩解關鍵供應商的疑慮，大型科技公司開始為長期協議提供保障。
此外，隨著美國傳出考慮禁止新款中國光收發器上市，業界也正為供應進一步吃緊做準備。Counterpoint Research指出，若光迅科技(Innolight)等中國廠商留下供應缺口，Lumentum與Coherent也無法完全填補。
為因應激增的需求，Lumentum過去兩年已將東京都會區主要工廠的產能擴大至12倍。該公司計劃在該廠及鄰近設施投資至少3.5億美元，並已擴充位於英國卡斯威爾(Caswell)的工廠產能。
不過Hurlston表示，若要擴大產品線，可能必須考慮透過併購取得新技術或能力。他說：「我認為，我們可能希望在未來一年內，為現有業務增加額外的產能。」
Hurlston表示，像Lumentum這類公司，通常需要三到五年才能建置新的產能，不過超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)已同意投入資金支持。

矽光子技術受矚目 日本供應鏈握優勢

矽光子技術利用光傳輸資料。由於先進AI硬體對傳輸速度的要求不斷提高，矽光子預料將逐步取代資料中心叢集內以銅為基礎的互連技術。光學網路也有助於降低系統產生的熱量與耗電量。
日本擁有廣泛的相關技術供應鏈，涵蓋磷化銦半導體、光纖及矽光子技術，代表企業包括藤倉(Fujikura)、住友電工(Sumitomo Electric Industries)、古河電工(Furukawa Electric)、濱松光子學(Hamamatsu Photonics)、三菱電機(Mitsubishi Electric)及日立高新技術(Hitachi High-Tech)。
Lumentum部分技術來自日本，因該公司在2018年收購承接了日立(Hitachi)光學研究成果的Oclaro。Lumentum位於日本相模原的廠區，如今已是全球最先進的磷化銦元件生產據點之一，具備穩定供應高品質產品的能力。
今年稍早，以色列矽光子晶圓代工業者Tower Semiconductor取得日本中部富山縣魚津市一座300毫米晶圓廠的控制權，並計劃擴大光子產品出貨量。

paras_en: Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) CEO Michael Hurlston said on Friday (the 9th) that, as the tech industry races to build faster AI data centers, the company’s optical component capacity through early 2029 is already "fully booked."

Hurlston told reporters in Tokyo that demand for some of the company’s products from now until next year will be about 70% unmet, and the shortfall for other products will remain at roughly 30% even through 2028. Just six months ago, Hurlston had said Lumentum’s capacity would not be sold out until 2028.

Earlier this year Lumentum and peer Coherent (COHR-US) each secured a $2 billion investment from Nvidia (NVDA-US). Lumentum supplies advanced indium phosphide components that enable high‑speed cloud computing and data transmission. Analysts expect Lumentum’s revenue this year to more than double that of last year.

Hurlston said, "We are really working hard to catch up, expanding capacity as quickly as possible, but we are still far, far behind customer demand. Capacity is completely sold out, so we can’t see when demand will ever run out."

AI infrastructure demand is strong, but suppliers’ capacity expansions are still lagging. As data centers and other AI infrastructure are built worldwide, some investors are becoming more cautious about rising costs and debt. To ease key suppliers’ concerns, large tech firms are beginning to provide guarantees for long‑term agreements.

In addition, with reports that the United States is considering banning new Chinese optical transceivers from the market, the industry is preparing for tighter supply. Counterpoint Research notes that if Chinese firms such as Innolight leave a supply gap, Lumentum and Coherent will not be able to fill it completely.

To meet the surge in demand, Lumentum has expanded capacity at its main plant in the Tokyo metropolitan area twelve‑fold over the past two years. The company plans to invest at least $350 million in that plant and nearby facilities and has also expanded capacity at its factory in Caswell, United Kingdom.

However, Hurlston said that expanding the product line may require acquiring new technology or capabilities through acquisitions. He added, "I think we may want to add additional capacity to our existing business within the next year."
Hurlston noted that companies like Lumentum typically need three to five years to build new capacity, but hyperscale cloud providers have agreed to fund the effort.

Silicon‑photonics technology is attracting attention, and Japan’s supply chain holds an advantage. Silicon photonics uses light to transmit data. As advanced AI hardware demands ever‑higher transmission speeds, silicon photonics is expected to gradually replace copper‑based interconnects inside data‑center clusters. Optical networking also helps reduce system heat and power consumption.

Japan has a broad related‑technology supply chain covering indium‑phosphide semiconductors, optical fiber and silicon‑photonics, with representative companies including Fujikura, Sumitomo Electric Industries, Furukawa Electric, Hamamatsu Photonics, Mitsubishi Electric and Hitachi High‑Tech.

Some of Lumentum’s technology comes from Japan, as the company acquired Oclaro in 2018, which had taken over Hitachi’s optical research results. Lumentum’s plant in Sagamihara, Japan, is now one of the world’s most advanced indium‑phosphide component production sites, capable of reliably supplying high‑quality products.

Earlier this year, Israeli silicon‑photonics wafer foundry Tower Semiconductor acquired control of a 300‑mm wafer fab in Uozu, Toyama Prefecture, Japan, and plans to expand its photonics product shipments.

items.title: 馬斯克拍板Terafab主導權特斯拉與SpaceX規劃逾1000億美元晶片投資
items.title_en: Musk Approves Tesla and SpaceX to Lead Terafab, Planning Over $100 Billion Chip Investment
paras: 2026年10月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克明確表示，Terafab半導體計畫將由特斯拉與SpaceX共同持有並負責營運，而非交由外部晶圓代工廠主導。消息帶動特斯拉週五盤前股價上漲約1%，報379美元。
Terafab預計落腳美國德州，整體投資規模將超過1,000億美元，首階段投入約100億至200億美元，由特斯拉與SpaceX共同出資。馬斯克規劃最終建置面積達1億平方英尺的半導體園區，整合晶片製造、先進封裝、組裝及測試，規模約為特斯拉德州電動車超級工廠的10倍，也是台積電目前亞利桑那州晶圓廠的30倍。
馬斯克認為，半導體供應能力將成為AI發展的重要瓶頸，因此希望透過自建產能，支援特斯拉自動駕駛、Robotaxi及人形機器人等業務需求。目前英特爾Intel(INTC-US)與台積電(2330-TW)均參與相關合作，但馬斯克強調，Terafab的所有權與營運權仍由特斯拉及SpaceX掌握，台積電等合作夥伴未來可選擇租用廠區空間。
市場預期，特斯拉將在10月21日公布第三季財報時進一步說明Terafab進度。華爾街目前預估第三季營收為283億美元，高於去年同期的281億美元，但每股盈餘預估為0.45美元，低於去年同期的0.50美元。Tigress Financial則維持特斯拉買進評等，目標價550美元，看好其AI、自動駕駛及機器人業務的長期發展。

paras_en: October 9, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk said clearly that the Terafab semiconductor project will be jointly owned and operated by Tesla and SpaceX, rather than being handed over to an external foundry. The news lifted Tesla's pre‑market price on Friday by about 1%, to $379.

Terafab is expected to be located in Texas, with a total investment exceeding $100 billion. The first phase will involve an outlay of roughly $10 billion to $20 billion, funded jointly by Tesla and SpaceX. Musk envisions a final semiconductor campus of 100 million square feet, integrating chip fabrication, advanced packaging, assembly and testing. The site would be about ten times the size of Tesla’s Texas Gigafactory and thirty times the size of TSMC’s current Arizona fab.

Musk believes semiconductor supply will become a critical bottleneck for AI development, so he wants to build capacity in‑house to support Tesla’s autonomous driving, Robotaxi and humanoid robot businesses. Intel (INTC-US) and TSMC (2330‑TW) are already involved in related collaborations, but Musk stressed that ownership and operational control of Terafab will remain with Tesla and SpaceX, with partners like TSMC able to lease space in the facility if they wish.

The market expects Tesla to provide further updates on Terafab when it releases its Q3 earnings on October 21. Wall Street currently forecasts Q3 revenue of $28.3 billion, up from $28.1 billion a year ago, but EPS is projected at $0.45, down from $0.50 a year ago. Tigress Financial maintains a buy rating on Tesla with a target price of $550, citing confidence in its AI, autonomous driving and robotics long‑term prospects.
